# IWMMD 1.1.2

IWMMD 1.1.2 fixes trusted proxy handling so audit logs, sessions, and request logs use the real client address behind a reverse proxy.

## Fixes

### Trusted proxies

- `IWMMD_TRUSTED_PROXIES` is now applied at runtime.
- Accepts comma-separated CIDRs and bare IP addresses, including IPv4 and IPv6.
- Reads `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Real-IP` only when the immediate peer is trusted.
- Walks `X-Forwarded-For` from the proxy side, ignoring spoofed leftmost values.
- Audit entries, session records, and HTTP request logs use the resolved client address.
- Invalid trusted proxy entries fail startup instead of being silently ignored.

Example for a reverse proxy running on the Docker host:

```env
IWMMD_TRUSTED_PROXIES=172.25.0.1/32
```

Use the proxy container address or Docker network CIDR when the proxy runs in the same Compose network. Prefer a single address or the narrowest possible range.

This release also includes the 1.1.1 expiry-horizon, Settings, and delivery-outbox fixes.

## Upgrade from 1.1.1

There is no database migration. Stop IWMMD, replace the container image or binary, and start it again.

Container users:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.2
```

Set `IWMMD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.2` in `.env` to pin the release.

Binary users:

```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/MrWeez/iwmmd/releases/download/v1.1.2/iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_amd64/iwmmd /usr/local/bin/iwmmd
iwmmd version
```

Replace `amd64` with `arm64` on ARM servers.

## Release assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_amd64` | Raw static binary for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_arm64` | Raw static binary for ARM64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.2_linux_arm64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for ARM64 Linux |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for all binary assets |

Verify downloaded assets:

```sh
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing checksums.txt
```

## Container image

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.2
```

Published image tags: `1.1.2`, `1.1`, `1`, `latest`, and `sha-<commit>`.
